svg.title: Beryl against OpenSSL: public keys and certificates
svg.desc: Median of ten rounds on an Apple M4. Curves: X25519 key generation 1.15× as fast, X25519 shared secret 1.013× slower, Ed25519 key generation 1.16× as fast, Ed25519 sign 1.088× as fast, Ed25519 verify 1.38× as fast, P-256 key generation 1.43× as fast, P-256 ECDSA sign 1.074× slower, P-256 ECDSA verify 1.096× as fast, P-256 ECDH shared secret 1.1× slower, P-384 ECDSA verify 1.41× as fast. RSA, PKCS #1 v1.5: RSA-2048 sign 1.069× as fast, RSA-2048 verify 1.5× slower, RSA-2048 OAEP decrypt 1.078× as fast, RSA-3072 sign 1.51× slower, RSA-3072 verify 1.58× slower, RSA-4096 sign 1.62× slower, RSA-4096 verify 1.63× slower. Certificates: Read 256 certificates 6.26× as fast, Read 256, keys decoded 4.09× slower, Verify a chain, ECDSA leaf 1.54× slower, Verify a chain, RSA leaf 2.01× slower.
